words.english_meaning: Track and field sports including running, jumping, and throwing events.
words.gujarati_meaning: દોડ, કૂદ અને ફેંક જેવી રમતોનો સમૂહ જે ટ્રૅક અને ફીલ્ડ પર રમાય છે.
words.usage_note: Used broadly for competitive physical sports, especially Olympic track and field events.
examples: She excels in athletics, especially sprinting.
The athletics meet drew thousands of spectators.
He trained hard for the national athletics championship.
Athletics requires speed, strength, and agility.

words.english_meaning: Running at full speed over a short distance.
words.gujarati_meaning: ટૂંકા અંતર સુધી પૂરી ઝડપે દોડવું.
words.usage_note: Refers to short-distance full-speed runs, typically 100m, 200m, or 400m.
examples: Sprinting requires explosive leg power.
He focused on sprinting for the Olympics.
She won the sprinting event at school.
Proper technique is key in sprinting.

words.english_meaning: A sport involving exercises requiring balance, strength, flexibility, agility, and coordination.
words.gujarati_meaning: સંતુલન, શક્તિ, લવચીકતા અને સંકલન જરૂરી હોય તેવી કસરતોની રમત.
words.usage_note: Includes artistic, rhythmic, and trampoline disciplines in Olympic sports.
words.memory_tip: 'Gym' = જિમ → gymnastics = જિમ જેવી કળાત્મક કસરત.
examples: She started gymnastics at age four.
Gymnastics demands incredible flexibility.
The gymnastics team won gold at the Olympics.
He performs breathtaking gymnastics routines.

words.english_meaning: A combat sport involving grappling techniques to pin or throw an opponent.
words.gujarati_meaning: વિરોધીને ઉઠાવવા અથવા પટકાવવા માટે ઝઝૂમવાની રમત.
words.usage_note: Olympic wrestling includes freestyle and Greco-Roman styles.
examples: Wrestling is one of the oldest sports in history.
He trained in wrestling since childhood.
The wrestling bout lasted three rounds.
She became a national wrestling champion.

words.english_meaning: The sport or practice of shooting arrows with a bow.
words.gujarati_meaning: ધનુષ્ય વડે તીર ચલાવવાની રમત.
words.usage_note: Both a competitive Olympic sport and a recreational hobby.
examples: Archery requires focus and steady hands.
She won a gold medal in archery.
The archery range was set up in the park.
He practiced archery every morning.

words.english_meaning: A sport in which two competitors fight using thin swords following specific rules.
words.gujarati_meaning: બે ખેલાડીઓ પાતળી તલવાર વડે ચોક્કસ નિયમો પ્રમાણે લડે તેવી રમત.
words.usage_note: Three weapons: foil, épée, and sabre. A classic Olympic sport.
examples: Fencing is a highly technical Olympic sport.
She learned fencing at the sports academy.
The fencing match ended in a tie.
He wore the full fencing uniform with a mask.

words.english_meaning: The sport of propelling a boat using oars.
words.gujarati_meaning: હલેસાં (ઓર) વડે હોડી ચલાવવાની રમત.
words.usage_note: Team rowing (crew) and single sculling are both Olympic disciplines.
words.memory_tip: 'Row' = હલેસું મારવું → rowing = હલેસાંથી હોડી હંકારવી.
examples: Rowing builds strong upper body muscles.
They joined the college rowing team.
Rowing on the river at dawn was peaceful.
The rowing final was an exciting race.

words.english_meaning: The sport or activity of riding a bicycle.
words.gujarati_meaning: સાઇકલ ચલાવવાની રમત અથવા પ્રવૃત્તિ.
words.usage_note: Includes road cycling, mountain biking, and track cycling in Olympics.
examples: Cycling is both a sport and a green transport.
She took up cycling to improve her fitness.
The Tour de France is the world's greatest cycling race.
Cycling strengthens the legs and improves stamina.

words.english_meaning: An endurance race combining swimming, cycling, and running done in sequence.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્વિમિંગ, સાઇક્લિંગ અને દોડ — ત્રણેય ક્રમમાં કરવાની સ્થૂળ સ્પર્ધા.
words.usage_note: 'Tri' means three — swim + bike + run. Ironman is the longest version.
examples: A triathlon tests your swimming, cycling, and running.
She completed her first triathlon last summer.
Triathlon training requires months of preparation.
The Ironman triathlon is extremely demanding.

words.english_meaning: Various combat practices used for self-defense, military, and sport.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્વ-રક્ષણ, લશ્કર અને રમત માટે ઉપયોગમાં લેવાતી વિવિધ લડાઈ-કળાઓ.
words.usage_note: Includes karate, judo, taekwondo, kung fu, and many other disciplines.
examples: He has practiced martial arts for ten years.
Martial arts teach discipline and self-control.
She earned a black belt in martial arts.
Martial arts classes are popular among children.

words.english_meaning: Relating to horse riding or the sport of horse riding.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘોડેસવારી સાથે સંબંધિત અથવા ઘોડેસવારીની રમત.
words.usage_note: Equestrian events include dressage, show jumping, and eventing in the Olympics.
examples: Equestrian sports require a strong bond with the horse.
She competed in equestrian dressage.
The equestrian event was held in the main arena.
Equestrian training starts from a young age.

words.english_meaning: A team sport in which players hit a ball over a net using their hands.
words.gujarati_meaning: બે ટીમો નેટ ઉપર બૉલ મારે તેવી ટીમ-રમત.
words.usage_note: Played indoors and on beaches. Each team has six players indoors.
examples: They played volleyball on the beach.
Volleyball requires teamwork and coordination.
She is the setter on the volleyball team.
The volleyball final was thrilling to watch.

words.english_meaning: A racket sport played with a shuttlecock over a net.
words.gujarati_meaning: નેટ ઉપર શટલ્કૉક મારીને રૅકેટ વડે રમાતી રમત.
words.usage_note: The shuttlecock must not touch the ground. Singles and doubles formats exist.
words.memory_tip: 'Badminton' = ઇંગ્લૅન્ડના Badminton ગામ પરથી → badminton = શટલ-રૅકેટ રમત.
examples: Badminton is very popular in India and China.
She won the badminton doubles title.
He plays badminton every evening.
The badminton court was packed with spectators.

words.english_meaning: A racket sport played in an enclosed court where players hit a rubber ball against walls.
words.gujarati_meaning: બંધ કોર્ટમાં ખેલાડીઓ રૅકેટ વડે રબ્બરના બૉલને દીવાલ પર મારે તેવી રમત.
words.usage_note: Squash is played in a four-walled enclosed court. Very fast-paced sport.
examples: Squash is one of the best cardiovascular sports.
He played squash at the club every weekend.
The squash court was booked for three hours.
She trains in squash six days a week.

words.english_meaning: A team sport played on horseback in which players use mallets to hit a ball into the opposing team's goal.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘોડા પર સવાર ખેલાડીઓ મૅલેટ વડે બૉલ વિરોધી ટીમના ગોલમાં ઠોકે તેવી ટીમ-રમત.
words.usage_note: One of the world's oldest team sports, played on a large grass field.
examples: Polo is known as the sport of kings.
He learned polo at a young age.
The polo match attracted a wealthy crowd.
Water polo is different from horse polo.

words.english_meaning: An athletic competition consisting of ten different track and field events.
words.gujarati_meaning: દસ વિવિધ ટ્રૅક અને ફીલ્ડ ઇવૅન્ટ્સ ધરાવતી એથ્લૅટિક્સ સ્પર્ધા.
words.usage_note: 'Deca' means ten. Winner is often called 'world's greatest athlete'.
examples: The decathlon spans two days of competition.
He won the Olympic decathlon gold medal.
Decathlon athletes must be all-round performers.
She trains for the decathlon year-round.

words.english_meaning: Water-based sports including swimming, diving, water polo, and synchronized swimming.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્વિમિંગ, ડાઇવિંગ, વૉટર પોલો સહિત પાણી આધારિત રમતો.
words.usage_note: Aquatics is an umbrella term for all competitive water sports in the Olympics.
examples: The aquatics centre hosted the swimming finals.
She excels in aquatics, especially freestyle.
Aquatics events were the most popular at the Games.
He trains at the aquatics club daily.

words.english_meaning: A period of gentle exercise done before more intense physical activity to prepare the body.
words.gujarati_meaning: વધુ જોરદાર શારીરિક પ્રવૃત્તિ પહેલાં શરીરને તૈયાર કરવા હળવી કસરત.
words.usage_note: Essential before any workout to prevent injury and improve performance.
words.memory_tip: 'Warm' = ગરમ + 'up' = ઉપર → warm-up = શરીર ગરમ કરવું.
examples: Always do a warm-up before running.
The team's warm-up lasted fifteen minutes.
A proper warm-up prevents muscle injuries.
She skipped her warm-up and pulled a muscle.

words.english_meaning: Light exercise done after intense activity to gradually reduce heart rate.
words.gujarati_meaning: જોરદાર કસરત પછી ધીમે ધીમે હૃદય ગતિ ઘટાડવા હળવી કસરત.
words.usage_note: Helps reduce muscle soreness and aids in recovery after workouts.
words.memory_tip: 'Cool' = ઠંડો + 'down' = નીચે → cool-down = ધીમે ઠંડું પડવું.
examples: The coach insisted on a proper cool-down.
Cool-down stretches prevent next-day soreness.
She always does a cool-down after training.
A five-minute cool-down is recommended after cardio.

words.english_meaning: A training method alternating between high-intensity bursts and rest or low-intensity periods.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઊંચી તીવ્રતા અને આરામ/ઓછી તીવ્રતા — ક્રમ-ક્રમથી ચાલુ-બંધ પ્રશિક્ષણ.
words.usage_note: Also called HIIT (High-Intensity Interval Training). Very effective for fat loss.
words.memory_tip: 'Interval' = વિરામ → interval training = વિરામ-સહિત ઉચ્ચ-તીવ્ર અભ્યાસ.
examples: Interval training burns more calories than steady jogging.
He followed an interval training schedule.
Interval training improves cardiovascular fitness rapidly.
The coach designed an interval training plan.

words.english_meaning: The ability to sustain prolonged physical exertion over a long period.
words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી શારીરિક પ્રયત્ન ટકાવી રાખવાની ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: Key quality for long-distance runners, swimmers, and cyclists.
examples: Marathon runners must build exceptional endurance.
Endurance training helps the heart work efficiently.
Her endurance in the race was remarkable.
He trains his endurance with long runs.

words.english_meaning: The ability to move quickly and easily, changing direction rapidly.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઝડપથી અને સરળતાથી ફરવાની, ઝડપથી દિશા બદલવાની ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: Important for football, basketball, and tennis players who need to change direction fast.
examples: Agility drills helped him dodge defenders.
Football players need agility to be effective.
Her agility on the court was impressive.
Agility training involves ladder and cone drills.

words.english_meaning: The range of motion available in a joint or group of joints.
words.gujarati_meaning: સાંધા અથવા સ્નાયુઓ કેટલી હદ સુધી વળી/ખેંચી શકાય તે ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: Yoga, stretching, and Pilates are common flexibility training methods.
examples: Yoga greatly improves flexibility.
Flexibility reduces the risk of muscle injuries.
She has remarkable flexibility for a sprinter.
Flexibility training should be done daily.

words.english_meaning: Exercise designed to improve muscular strength through resistance and weights.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્નાયુ-શક્તિ વધારવા પ્રતિકાર (વજન) સહિત કરવામાં આવતી કસરત.
words.usage_note: Uses free weights, machines, or bodyweight exercises like push-ups and squats.
examples: Strength training helps prevent bone loss.
He incorporated strength training three times a week.
Strength training is essential for athletes.
Her strength training routine includes deadlifts.

words.english_meaning: Relating to the heart and blood vessels; describing exercises that raise the heart rate.
words.gujarati_meaning: હૃદય અને રક્તવાહિનીઓ સાથે સંબંધિત; હૃદય-ગતિ વધારે તેવી કસરત.
words.usage_note: Cardio exercises like running, swimming, and cycling improve heart health.
examples: Running is an excellent cardiovascular exercise.
She improved her cardiovascular fitness.
Cardiovascular health is crucial for athletes.
The doctor recommended cardiovascular workouts.

words.english_meaning: One complete movement of an exercise, commonly called a 'rep'.
words.gujarati_meaning: કસરતની એક પૂર્ણ ગતિ, સામાન્ય રીતે 'રૅપ' કહેવાય.
words.usage_note: In weightlifting, sets and reps define the structure of a workout.
words.memory_tip: 'Repeat' = ફરી કરવું → repetition = ફરી ફરી કસરત.
examples: Do three sets of twelve repetitions.
He increased his repetitions to build endurance.
Each repetition must be done with proper form.
Ten repetitions of squats is a good start.

words.english_meaning: Repeated practice exercises done to improve a specific skill or technique.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચોક્કસ કૌશલ્ય સુધારવા વારંવાર કરવામાં આવતી અભ્યાસ-કસરતો.
words.usage_note: Used in team sports (football, basketball) and individual sports alike.
examples: The coach ran passing drills for an hour.
Football drills improve ball control.
She practiced shooting drills every morning.
Agility drills help players change direction fast.

words.english_meaning: Training that improves overall physical fitness, strength, and performance.
words.gujarati_meaning: એકંદર શારીરિક ફિટનૅસ, શક્તિ અને પ્રદર્શન સુધારતી ટ્રેઇનિંગ.
words.usage_note: Pre-season conditioning prepares athletes for the rigors of competition.
examples: Pre-season conditioning is crucial for players.
His conditioning program lasted three months.
Physical conditioning improves game performance.
The team's conditioning improved throughout the season.

words.english_meaning: Exercises involving explosive jumping and stretching movements to build power.
words.gujarati_meaning: શક્તિ વધારવા ઝડપી કૂદ અને ખેંચ-ગતિ ધરાવતી કસરતો.
words.usage_note: Includes box jumps, burpees, and bounding exercises. Great for athletes.
examples: Plyometrics improved her vertical jump.
Box jumps are a common plyometrics exercise.
Plyometric training builds explosive speed.
The team added plyometrics to their regimen.

words.english_meaning: A workout format with a series of exercises performed one after another with minimal rest.
words.gujarati_meaning: એકથી વધારે કસરતો ક્રમ-ક્રમ, ઓછા આરામ સાથે કરવાનો વ્યાયામ-ક્રમ.
words.usage_note: Combines cardio and strength in one session. Time-efficient workout.
examples: Circuit training combines cardio and strength.
She completed three circuits in forty minutes.
Circuit training is efficient for busy people.
The gym offers morning circuit training classes.

words.english_meaning: The ability to sustain prolonged physical or mental effort.
words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય સુધી શારીરિક અથવા માનસિક પ્રયત્ન ટકાવી રાખવાની ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: Used for both physical (running a marathon) and mental (studying for hours) endurance.
words.memory_tip: 'sta' = ઊભા રહો + 'mina' = strength → stamina = ટકી રહેવાની શક્તિ.
examples: Marathon runners need incredible stamina.
She built her stamina through daily training.
The job requires mental stamina.
His stamina impressed the coach.

words.english_meaning: Excessive training that causes fatigue, decreased performance, and risk of injury.
words.gujarati_meaning: અત્યધિક ટ્રેઇનિંગ જે થાક, કામગીરીમાં ઘટાડો અને ઈજાનું જોખમ ઉભું કરે.
words.usage_note: Signs include constant fatigue, mood changes, and declining performance.
words.memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'training' = ટ્રેઇનિંગ → overtraining = ઘણી વધારે ટ્રેઇનિંગ.
examples: Overtraining can lead to serious injury.
He showed symptoms of overtraining.
Avoid overtraining by scheduling rest days.
The coach warned against overtraining.

words.english_meaning: A structured training plan that divides the season into phases to optimize performance.
words.gujarati_meaning: મોસમને ઇષ્ટ પ્રદર્શન માટે તબક્કાઓમાં વહેંચી ટ્રેઇનિંગ-આયોજન.
words.usage_note: Involves macrocycles, mesocycles, and microcycles to peak at the right time.
examples: Periodization helps athletes peak at competitions.
The coach applied periodization to the training plan.
Periodization prevents burnout and overtraining.
Olympic athletes use periodization strategies.

words.english_meaning: Training in different sports or exercises to improve overall fitness.
words.gujarati_meaning: એકંદર ફિટનૅસ સુધારવા વિભિન્ન રમતો અથવા કસરતોથી ટ્રેઇનિંગ.
words.usage_note: Swimmers may run or cycle to work different muscles and prevent injury.
examples: Cross-training reduces the risk of overuse injuries.
She uses cycling as cross-training for running.
Cross-training keeps workouts interesting.
The athlete added cross-training to improve balance.

words.english_meaning: A series of contests in which many competitors play against each other.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘણા ખેલાડીઓ/ટીમો એકબીજા સામે ખેલે તેવી સ્પર્ધા-શ્રૃંખલા.
words.usage_note: Can be knockout (single elimination), round-robin, or double elimination format.
examples: She won the state badminton tournament.
The tournament attracted players from six countries.
He lost in the quarterfinals of the tournament.
The tournament prize money was substantial.

words.english_meaning: A match or round that determines who will compete in the final.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફાઇનલ માટે કોણ ક્વૉલિફાઇ કરે તે નક્કી કરતી મૅચ.
words.usage_note: Two winners of the two semifinals play in the final.
examples: They reached the semifinal of the World Cup.
She lost the semifinal by a narrow margin.
The semifinal was an intense match.
Both semifinal winners advance to the final.

words.english_meaning: A match or round that determines who advances to the main competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: મુખ્ય સ્પર્ધામાં આગળ કોણ જાય તે નક્કી કરતી મૅચ.
words.usage_note: Athletes must perform well in qualifiers to earn a spot in the main event.
examples: She ran her best time in the qualifier.
The qualifier was held two weeks before the main event.
He passed the Olympic qualifier.
Only top performers survive the qualifier.

words.english_meaning: A stage in a competition where the loser is eliminated from the competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્પર્ધામાં જ્યાં હારનારી ટીમ/ખેલાડી સ્પર્ધામાંથી બહાર થઈ જાય.
words.usage_note: In boxing, a knockout (KO) means rendering an opponent unable to continue.
words.memory_tip: 'Knock out' = બહાર ફેંકવું → knockout = એક હારે, બહાર.
examples: The team reached the knockout stage.
A knockout punch ended the boxing match.
The knockout round featured the top sixteen teams.
They were eliminated in the knockout stage.

words.english_meaning: The raised platform where medal winners stand at sports events.
words.gujarati_meaning: રમત-સ્પર્ધામાં મૅડલ-વિજેતા ઊભા રહે તેવ ઊંચો ઓટો.
words.usage_note: A 'podium finish' means finishing in the top three (gold, silver, bronze).
words.memory_tip: 'Pod' = પગ → podium = ઊભા રહેવાનો ઊંચો ઓટો.
examples: The athlete stood on the podium with a gold medal.
A podium finish was her goal.
Three athletes shared the podium at the ceremony.
He reached the podium for the first time in his career.

words.english_meaning: The process of ranking competitors so that the strongest do not meet in early rounds.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્પર્ધાની શરૂઆતમાં સૌથી મજબૂત ખેલાડી ન ભટકાય તે માટે ક્રમ-નિર્ધારણ.
words.usage_note: The top seed is the highest-ranked player expected to win the tournament.
words.memory_tip: 'Seed' = બીજ → seeding = ખૂબ સારો ખેલાડી (ઉત્તમ બીજ).
examples: She was the top seed at the tournament.
Seeding ensures the best players avoid early clashes.
He was seeded third in the draw.
The seeding was based on world rankings.

words.english_meaning: A tiebreaker in football where players take turns shooting at goal from the penalty spot.
words.gujarati_meaning: ફૂટબૉલમાં ટાઇ-બ્રેકર, જ્યાં ખેલાડીઓ પૅનલ્ટી સ્પૉટ પરથી ગોલ ઠોકે.
words.usage_note: Each team takes five penalty kicks alternately; then sudden death if still tied.
examples: They won the World Cup on a penalty shootout.
The penalty shootout was nerve-wracking.
He scored the winning penalty in the shootout.
A penalty shootout decided the final result.

words.english_meaning: Extra time added at the end of a game when the score is tied.
words.gujarati_meaning: મૅચ ટાઇ હોય ત્યારે અંતે ઉમેરાતો વધારાનો સમય.
words.usage_note: In basketball (NBA), overtime is five minutes. Football uses extra time of 30 minutes.
examples: The game went into overtime after a last-second tie.
She scored the winner in overtime.
Overtime can be exhausting for players.
They clinched the title in overtime.

words.english_meaning: An official who enforces the rules of a sport during a match.
words.gujarati_meaning: મૅચ દરમ્યાન રમત-નિયમો લાગુ કરનારો અધિકારી.
words.usage_note: 'Referee' is used in football, boxing, and basketball; 'umpire' in cricket and tennis.
examples: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
Players must respect the referee's decision.
He became a certified football referee.
The referee showed a red card.

words.english_meaning: A count of gold, silver, and bronze medals won by each country in a competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ્પર્ધામાં દરેક દેશ દ્વારા જીતેલ સોના, ચાંદી અને કાંસ્ય-મૅડલ ગણતરી.
words.usage_note: Countries are ranked by gold medals first, then silver, then bronze.
examples: India improved its Olympic medal tally.
China topped the medal tally.
The medal tally was updated after every event.
A bronze medal added to the national tally.

words.english_meaning: The best performance ever achieved in a particular sport or event globally.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ચોક્કસ રમત અથવા ઇવૅન્ટમાં વૈશ્વિક સ્તરે અત્યાર સુધીનો સ્રેષ્ઠ દેખાવ.
words.usage_note: World records are ratified by the respective international sports federation.
examples: Usain Bolt holds the 100m world record.
She broke the world record in the javelin throw.
Setting a world record is a career achievement.
The world record has stood for over a decade.

words.english_meaning: The removal of a competitor from a contest for breaking the rules.
words.gujarati_meaning: નિયમ ભંગ બદલ ખેલાડીને સ્પર્ધામાંથી બહાર કરવું.
words.usage_note: Can occur for false starts, doping, illegal equipment, or unsporting conduct.
examples: He faced disqualification for a false start.
Doping led to her disqualification.
The team received a disqualification for fielding an ineligible player.
Disqualification cost him a gold medal.

words.english_meaning: A large display board showing the current score and other information during a game.
words.gujarati_meaning: રમત દરમ્યાન વર્તમાન સ્કોર અને અન્ય માહિતી દર્શાવતું મોટું ડિસ્પ્લે-બોર્ડ.
words.usage_note: Modern scoreboards show live stats, replays, and player information.
examples: Everyone's eyes were on the scoreboard.
The scoreboard showed a tied game.
The electronic scoreboard updated instantly.
She glanced at the scoreboard during the break.

words.english_meaning: A major international racing or sports competition, especially in Formula 1.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાસ કરીને ફૉર્મ્યુલા 1 માં, એક મોટી આંતરરાષ્ટ્રીય સ્પર્ધા.
words.usage_note: French for 'big prize'. Used across motorsports, cycling, and other sports.
words.memory_tip: 'Grand' = મોટો + 'Prix' = ઇનામ → Grand Prix = મોટો ઇનામ-ઇવૅન્ટ.
examples: Lewis Hamilton won the Monaco Grand Prix.
The Grand Prix attracts millions of viewers.
She participated in the gymnastics Grand Prix.
The Grand Prix season spans multiple continents.

words.english_meaning: A group of sports teams that play against each other over a season.
words.gujarati_meaning: રમત-ટીમોનો સ્તર, જ્યાં ટીમો સીઝન દરમ્યાન એકબીજા સામે ખેલે.
words.usage_note: Teams earn points throughout the season; the highest ranked wins the league title.
examples: Manchester City won the Premier League.
The team finished fourth in the league.
She plays in the national volleyball league.
League matches are held every weekend.

words.english_meaning: An entry into a sports competition given to a competitor who did not qualify through normal means.
words.gujarati_meaning: સામાન્ય ક્વૉલિફિ-પ્રક્રિયા વગર ખેલાડીને સ્પર્ધામાં પ્રવૃત્તિ-મૂળ.
words.usage_note: Organisers grant wildcards to attract top players or promising talent.
examples: She received a wildcard into the Grand Slam.
The wildcard player upset the top seed.
He was granted a wildcard at the last minute.
Wildcards are common in tennis tournaments.

words.english_meaning: The ranking of teams or players in a league or competition at any given point.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ ચોક્કસ સમયે લીગ અથવા સ્પર્ધામાં ટીમ/ખેલાડીઓની ક્રમ-સૂચી.
words.usage_note: Updated after every match; determines who advances or is relegated.
examples: The standings changed after yesterday's matches.
They climbed to third in the standings.
Check the standings for the latest rankings.
She leads the tennis standings this year.

words.english_meaning: A machine for running or walking on a moving belt, used for indoor exercise.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઘરે કે જિમમાં ચાલવા/દોડવા માટે ફરતી પટ્ટી ધરાવતું મશીન.
words.usage_note: Allows control of speed and incline; good for indoor cardio training.
examples: She ran five kilometres on the treadmill.
The treadmill allows speed adjustments.
He uses the treadmill for rainy-day runs.
Treadmill workouts are great for beginners.

words.english_meaning: A long metal bar with weights at each end used for weightlifting exercises.
words.gujarati_meaning: વેઇટ-ઉઠ્ઠો કસરત માટે બંને છેડે ભાર ધરાવતો લાંબો ધાતુ-દ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Used in Olympic weightlifting and powerlifting for squats, deadlifts, and bench press.
examples: He loaded the barbell with 100kg.
Barbell squats build leg strength.
The barbell slipped and was caught by the spotter.
She included barbell rows in her routine.

words.english_meaning: A short bar with a weight at each end, held in one hand during exercise.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક હાથમાં પકડવા માટે બંને છેડે ભાર ધરાવતો ટૂંકો ધાતુ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Come in fixed or adjustable weights. Great for isolation exercises.
examples: She lifted 5kg dumbbells for bicep curls.
Dumbbells are versatile gym tools.
He bought adjustable dumbbells for home.
Dumbbell exercises target individual muscles.

words.english_meaning: A cast-iron ball with a handle used for ballistic exercises combining strength and cardio.
words.gujarati_meaning: હૅન્ડલ ધરાવતો લોખંડ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Kettlebell swings are one of the most effective full-body exercises.
examples: He swings a 24kg kettlebell for power.
Kettlebell training burns fat efficiently.
She learned the kettlebell snatch technique.
Kettlebells are now standard gym equipment.

words.english_meaning: An elastic band used to add resistance to exercises for strength training.
words.gujarati_meaning: કસરતમાં પ્રતિ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Light, portable, and affordable alternative to weights for strength training.
examples: She uses resistance bands for leg workouts.
Resistance bands are great for travel workouts.
He added resistance bands to his rehabilitation.
Resistance band exercises improve muscle tone.

words.english_meaning: A protective pad worn on the front of the lower leg during contact sports.
words.gujarati_meaning: સ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Mandatory in football and hockey to protect against kicks and impacts.
examples: He forgot his shin guards at home.
Shin guards are mandatory in football.
She bought new shin guards for the season.
Proper shin guards prevent serious injuries.

words.english_meaning: A protective device worn over the teeth during contact sports to prevent dental injuries.
words.gujarati_meaning: ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Essential in boxing, rugby, and hockey to prevent tooth and jaw injuries.
examples: Boxers always wear a mouthguard.
He had a custom mouthguard made.
The mouthguard protected his teeth during rugby.
A mouthguard is essential safety equipment.

words.english_meaning: A long spear-like implement thrown in an athletics field event.
words.gujarati_meaning: ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Men's javelin weighs 800g; women's javelin weighs 600g.
examples: She set a national record in the javelin.
Javelin throwing requires technique and strength.
He launched the javelin 85 metres.
The javelin landed outside the sector and was disqualified.

words.english_meaning: A heavy disc thrown in an athletics field event.
words.gujarati_meaning: ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ-ˆ.
words.usage_note: Men's discus: 2kg. Women's: 1kg. Thrown from a circular throwing area.
examples: He set a new discus record.
Discus throwing is an Olympic track event.
The discus landed 65 metres from the throwing circle.
She trains the discus throw every day.
